name: Sasaki Chikako
source:
Class: 1st year student in the regular class
Zodiac sign: Aries
Musical Instrument: None
Hobbies: Playing with children in the park

Chikako is an airhead and a cheerful girl who is always bright. She is good at many things: studying, exercise, housework and cooking... But as an oppose to this, she is extremely illiterate.
Chikako doesn't play any instrument or sings, even though she would like to play a musical instrument or singing one day. She doesn't try playing anymore since a long time ago when she was in a brass band, she couldn't make even a single sound on a saxophone, and it is still a trauma for her.
Her surroundings are wondering why did she chose to attend a musical school in the first place, if she doesn't play anything. What they don't know is that Chikako's love for music simply cannot be helped.
Kazuki used to belong to the same brass band as her, she feels a strong longing for him.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=660669]Getchu (NSFW)[/url].]
